title: Pinnacle entries: Breachstones and An Audience with the King
summary: Turn Breach Splinters into Breachstones and watch Ritual windows for An Audience with the King, then sell the entries or run only the bosses: The King in the Mists drops Head of the King.

budget.why: Ordinary Breach and Ritual maps; the entries come out of them, nothing is bought.
budget.build_needs: Selling needs no boss kill; running the entries means pinnacle fights (Xesht, The King in the Mists).

claim.note: Our reading of the setup against the budget scale; not measured.

build.why: Running the entries is a pinnacle fight: Xesht, We That Are One, and The King in the Mists.

claim.note: Our reading of the cited facts against the build scale; selling the entries instead needs no kill.

complexity.why: Steps outside the map: splinters become a Revelatory Wombgift that grows into a Breachstone on the Genesis Tree, and the entries go into the Realmgate.

claim.note: Our reading of the strategy's own steps against the complexity scale; not measured.

durability.why_it_works: Breach Splinters stack into a Revelatory Wombgift that grows into a Breachstone, and An Audience with the King comes from Ritual: entries are made from map content, and the bosses they open drop uniques.
breaks_when: The splinter → Wombgift → Breachstone path or Ritual's Audience offer is changed
Entry prices fall below what their bosses drop

claim.note: Our reading of the cited mechanic. Whether it pays today is only what live prices show.

yields.why: Opens Xesht, We That Are One at the Realmgate. 300 Breach Splinters make a Revelatory Wombgift, which grows into a Breachstone on the Genesis Tree.
'Combine 300 Splinters to create a Revelatory Wombgift.' Splinters sell on their own if you do not grow them.
Opens The King in the Mists; very rarely offered in Ritual windows.

claim.note: maxroll boss loot cheat sheet (Cptn Garbage, updated 2026-09-24).

yields.why: Drops from The King in the Mists, so running your own Audience adds it to the boss's uniques.

claim.note: We only say it drops; the drop rate is not checked against game data.

nodes.name: Head of the Snake
nodes.effect: Pinnacle Bosses have 25% chance to drop an additional Unique item; Powerful Map Bosses have 5% chance when defeated to reveal a nearby Citadel; Pinnacle Bosses have a single Revive

claim.note: Our pick for running the entries yourself: an extra unique and a revive at pinnacle bosses. No master node targets Breach Splinters or Ritual windows.

waystone.notes: The bosses are entered at the Realmgate, not through a waystone; the Breach and Ritual maps that feed them need nothing specific.

claim.note: maxroll: the entries go 'into the Realmgate at the start of your Atlas'.

steps: Farm Breaches: 300 Breach Splinters combine into a Revelatory Wombgift, which grows into a Breachstone on the Genesis Tree.
Watch Ritual windows: An Audience with the King is very rarely offered there.
Compare each entry's exchange price with what its boss drops (Farm › Bosses prices pinnacle kills).
Sell the entry, or place it in the Realmgate: a Breachstone opens Xesht, We That Are One; An Audience with the King opens The King in the Mists, which drops Head of the King.
risks: Head of the King drops from The King in the Mists; we do not claim it always does.
The bosses' uniques have no exchange price here; the basket prices the entries only.
